about: General project know-how: tooling, setup, conventions and anything not yet big enough for its own pointer type
_rules: Semantic routing for one type of context: match the task to an entry, read its subject summary, then check its sources if needed. Its notes live in knowledge/<type>/ and sources in sources/<type>/. Open only the files an entry points to. Never browse knowledge/ or sources/ directly.

entries.title: GitHub sign-in and git API (src/lib/github.ts)
entries.summary: How the git buttons talk to GitHub: function names and shapes, client vs server imports, sign-in routes (Supabase GitHub provider with legacy fallback) and cookie, fake mode, and how to test against a local fake GitHub. Built-in fake file persistence covers only legacy COCOMMIT.md.

entries.title: Chat backend (src/lib/chat.ts, Supabase Realtime)
entries.summary: How chat works: functions and message shape, live updates and who is online, git events from github-client, table rules in supabase/schema.sql, and the browser-only fake mode. Only real accounts read, post or pin (no anonymous sessions; signed-out visitors see a login card); the database sets author and a verified GitHub @login; the screen uses a fixed repo. Chat actions save messages to workspace decisions/gotchas with GitHub login and workspace checks.

entries.title: AI context workspace (COCOMMIT/ folder: context.ts + workspace.ts)
entries.summary: The COCOMMIT/ team-context folder each repo gets: file layout, the load/save functions screens call, how LOG.md fills itself from commits/PRs/pinned chat, and the end-to-end test against a stateful fake GitHub. Service exists on main; Context screen wiring remains pending.

entries.title: Local git in the desktop app (Repo page Local mode, src/lib/local-git.ts)
entries.summary: How the desktop app's Repo page works on a local clone: the 12 Tauri git commands (Rust side merged: guards, dialog plugin, live-site-only permission), status parsing, the screen, safety rules, and testing in a normal browser with the Node git bridge.

entries.title: Account profile and settings (/profile)
entries.summary: Profile page/helper, saved auth metadata, own-row mirror, provider separation, sidebar refresh and fresh chat names; controlled tests and live verification limits.

entries.title: Desktop app (Tauri shell, builds, installers)
entries.summary: The Tauri window that loads the live site: window setup and new-window links (system browser), sign-in and cookies in WebView2, local/GitHub Actions builds for .msi/.exe/.dmg, unsigned-install steps, and testing the window through the WebView2 debug port.

entries.title: Email/password login and permissions (auth-email.ts, permissions.ts)
entries.summary: Email/password helpers (sign up, log in, reset, sign out, friendly errors), what email/Google/GitHub users may do (permissions.ts), the profiles name fallback, the screens (EmailLogin on /login, /login/forgot, /login/reset, live since PR #39), the live check (real sign-up passed 2026-10-16; reset email run not reported).

entries.title: Landing page and app routes (/ vs /home)
entries.summary: / is the marketing landing page (no sidebar); the app home is /home. How AppShell hides the sidebar, the landing components (commit-graph rail, hero demo, downloads), the desktop-app redirect, Get started (login page for visitors, /home when signed in), and every place that defaults to /home.

entries.title: Deploying the web app (auto-deploy from main via GitHub Actions)
entries.summary: How main reaches production: the deploy-vercel.yml workflow, its gate and checks, running it by hand or with force, the AUTO_DEPLOY pause switch, rollback/promote, the token location, and why Vercel's Git connection isn't used.

entries.title: @cocommit bot and Assistant: reads the whole repo (code, PRs, issues, any branch), Edit mode opens PRs, model choice, own API key, debug
entries.summary: How the bot works: files, the 15 read-only tools, the tarball snapshot per branch (5-min cache), the don't-read list, the Claude loop (12 rounds, 40 s guard, fallbacks on Sonnet/Opus), model choice, own key/URL rules, OpenAI-compatible format (Gemini etc.), debug trace, keys, and its tests. Edit mode: staged edits with diffs, Create pull request → /api/bot/apply (new assistant/ branch, one commit, PR).

entries.title: Calls with LiveKit (/calls, src/lib/livekit-token.ts)
entries.summary: How in-app calls work: the token route (signed-in only, HS256 JWT via node:crypto, one room per repo), the /calls screen with LiveKit's VideoConference, the three env keys, the macOS Info.plist for camera/mic, and why Discord calls can't be embedded.

entries.title: Tasks board (/tasks on the repo's COCOMMIT/BOARD/)
entries.summary: How /tasks reads and moves COCOMMIT/BOARD/ task files: one commit per move, edits that keep the rest of a hand-written file, Done adding a LOG.md line, file names (Thai titles), the 'already moved' check, fake mode, and how to test against the stateful mock GitHub.

entries.title: Commit activity heat map on /home (src/lib/heatmap.ts)
entries.summary: Grid of commits per day for the picked repo, per-person filter; pure bucketing in heatmap.ts, one read-only listCommitDates action, limits (default branch, 500 commits).

entries.title: Shared files: Drive (/files, COCOMMIT/files/)
entries.summary: How Drive (/files) works: files and folders (.keep markers, up to 4 deep) committed to COCOMMIT/files/ on the default branch; up to 50 MB per file, sent up (uploadPart + commitFiles parts) and down (downloadFile part, raw-host Range reads) in 3 MB pieces because of Vercel's 4.5 MB limit; fake mode, tests, and scripts/drive-live-check.mjs for real GitHub.

entries.title: Figma look in the app: theme tokens, glass navigation, Home tabs
entries.summary: How the app got the Figma design: colour tokens flip inside cards, glass nav in three sizes, shared ui components (Card tone, Tabs), full-screen auth, the Home tabs (Cards, Overview, Activity, Customize) with real data and honest empty states, and the polish pass (Messages group, floating Assistant, Repository diff layout, Drive, Profile and Context tabs, landing); what was left out because it has no data.
